notablePrerequisites:
Soul of Windgrace can attack without taking damage.
Savage Ventmaw can attack without taking damage.
description:
Declare Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Savage Ventmaw trigger, adding six mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Simic Growth Chamber, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
